seo.title: 5 Days Shillong Cherrapunji Tour Package
seo.description: Engage in our 5 Days Shillong Cherrapunji Tour Package and witness the best of Meghalaya. Book now for the best price & scenic getaway.

main.title: Package Includes
items: Hotel
Transportation
Breakfast

main.title: Tour Highlights
items: Discover the best of Meghalaya
Witness the grand Laitlum Canyons
Engage in Shillong Sightseeing
Explore the waterfalls of Cherrapunji
Visit the limestone caves like Mawsmai and Arwah Caves
Walk the unique root bridges for an amazing experience amidst nature
Visit the cleanest village of Asia-Mawlynnong Village
Witness the cleanest river-Umngot River

main.title: 5 Days Shillong Cherrapunji Tour Package Itinerary

days.title: Day 1 : Arrival & Shillong Exploration
items: Reach Guwahati Airport/Railway Station and drive to Shillong. (approx 3 hours).
You can visit Umiam Lake for panoramic views or optional water sports on your way to Shillong.
On reaching Shillong, check-in to your hotel and relax.
Explore the city highlight, like Laitlum Canyons.
Stroll through Police Bazar for local street food and shopping in the evening.

days.title: Day 2 : Explore the Waterfalls of Cherrapunji
items: Wake up to a lovely day, have breakfast and get ready to depart for Cherrapunji.
You can take a halt at the Mawkdok Dympep Valley Viewpoint for engaging in ziplining.
On reaching Cherrapunji, check-in to your hotel and relax for a while.
Visit Nohkalikai Falls, Seven Sisters Falls and the Mawsmai Cave.
You can also explore Arwah Caves for limestone formations if time permits.
Evenings can be spent in relaxing.

days.title: Day 3 : Living Root Bridges & Adventure
items: Wake up, have breakfast and get ready for a day's excursion to the Root bridges.
Head to Tyrna village and trek down approximately 3,000 steps to witness the Double Decker Living Root Bridge.
If time and energy permits, extend the trek further to reach the stunning Rainbow Falls.
After the excursion, return to your hotel and relax.

days.title: Day 4 : Mawlynnong Village & Dawki River
items: Wake up, start your day with comforting breakfast, take a check-out and get ready for an excursion to the Mawlynnong Village and Dawki.
On reaching Mawlynnong, explore the cleanest village in Asia and take a walk across the nearby Riwai Living Root Bridge.
Later, drive to the Indo-Bangladesh border and take a boat ride on the crystal-clear Umngot River.
Return to Shillong for an overnight stay.

days.title: Day 5 : Departure
items: Wake up to a refreshing day; after breakfast, take a check out and leave for a small sightseeing adventure.
You can explore Ward's Lake, Don Bosco Museum and Mary Cathedral Church.
After the excursion, head back to Guwahati for your flight or train.

items.text: Travellers visiting Meghalaya are required to register on Meghalaya Tourism App and generate an e-invite.
You can download the Meghalaya Tourism App from Google Play Store or App Store.
No reimbursement will be made against missed services.
Travellers are required to show their valid identity cards at the time of check-in to the hotel.
You should not consume alcohol or other intoxicants during your tour.
The vehicle allotted for the tour will be available as per the itinerary and not for general disposal.
In the Northeast, generally, vehicles like Sedan do not have carriers. You are advised to carry one bag per person. Kindly give us prior information in case you have more luggage.

Delay in arrival due to many reasons including flight reschedules shall have to inform to us at an earliest and in case of any sightseeing spot missed due to any delay including spending more time in one sightseeing spot, will not be refundable.

Kajaawa will provide accommodation as per the hotels in the list and in case the listed hotels cannot be provided for any reason like unavailability, scheduled or general maintenance, accident at the hotel, risky road conditions due to bad weather or political disturbance, similar hotels will be provided and you will be informed about the changes in advance.

In Deluxe and Premium Tour Packages, we will generally arrange Deluxe and Premium Hotels but in interior places, we will arrange Homestays, Guest Houses or Standard Hotels as Deluxe and Premium accommodations may not be available in the interiors for any reason.
In case of any unforeseen situations which are beyond our control including bad weather conditions, political disturbance etc., we may change your itinerary or dates of travel.
Travellers may have to bear additional expenses in case of natural calamity including situations like changes in the hotel, changes in tour date etc.
